BackstoryDef.title: vat-grown clone
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s first memory is of waking inside warm nutrient fluid under humming glass. The body was full-grown and the hands were steady, but every recollection outside the vats belonged to someone else - a life [PAWN_nameDef] never lived, pressed into a growing mind. The vats do not raise children. They issue replacements.

BackstoryDef.title: the wronged
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was not born to the rim's wars, but [PAWN_nameDef] was broken by one - or by debt, or by betrayal; the telling changes every time it is told. What never changes is where the blame lands. Somewhere out there is a people who, fairly or not, owe [PAWN_nameDef] a debt, and it has been compounding ever since.

BackstoryDef.title: master of the vats
BackstoryDef.description: A drifter at the rim's edge, [PAWN_nameDef] opened a hatch that appears on no chart and found the vats: dormant, dust-cloaked, older than any guild, built by nobody anyone can name. [PAWN_nameDef] did not ask where they came from. [PAWN_nameDef] woke them, taught them one face, and gave the growing army its single standing order - collect the debt, in full, from the people who owe it.
